subject.title: fix(ui): paginate sidebar session sections independently

question: Should the Control UI adopt independent pagination for every session section instead of retaining one shared sidebar session budget once a real interactive sidebar run confirms the reset and expansion behavior?
rationale: The patch changes an existing user-facing navigation model rather than correcting a clearly documented contract, and the supplied evidence does not independently establish current-main behavior or live after-fix behavior.

options.title: Adopt independent section pagination
options.body: Accept the per-section interaction after a redacted real-session run demonstrates independent expansion and reset behavior across the affected sidebar sections.

options.title: Retain the shared budget
options.body: Keep the existing single-page interaction if maintainers prefer a bounded total sidebar length over independent discovery controls.

recommendation.title: Adopt independent section pagination
recommendation.body: Accept the per-section interaction after a redacted real-session run demonstrates independent expansion and reset behavior across the affected sidebar sections.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as the active implementation contact; broader current-main ownership could not be established in this read-only review.
